name: Maine
agency: Maine Secretary of State, Bureau of Motor Vehicles (BMV)
permitAge: 15; under 18 must complete an approved driver education course; parent or guardian signs for applicants under 18

teen.supervisedHours: 70 hours, including 10 at night, starting after the permit is issued (under 21)
teen.nightLimit: Licensed drivers under 18: no driving from 12 a.m. to 5 a.m. for the first 270 days (handbook 1-4; 29-A 1311)
teen.passengerLimit: Licensed drivers under 18: no passengers other than immediate family unless a licensed driver at least 20, licensed 2 years, sits beside the driver; for 270 days, extended 270 days after a violation (29-A 1311)
teen.phone: Permit holders (any age) and licensed drivers under 18: no phone use at all while driving (29-A 1304, 1311). All drivers: no hand-held phone; hands-free only for drivers 18+ who are not on a permit or intermediate license (29-A 2121). Texting banned for all (29-A 2119).

bac.under21: any amount (more than 0.00); license suspended at least one year (29-A 2472)

notes: Handbook: Maine Driver's License Manual, English, page footer 'Rev 4/24' (PDF built 2026-08-28), downloaded from maine.gov 2026-10-09. Spanish, Arabic, French, Portuguese and Somali versions are rev. 05/2025.
The manual uses section page numbers (1-3, 3-14). Bank 'page' values are PDF page numbers (1-1 = PDF 6).
Supervisor: at least 20 years old, licensed at least 2 years, seated beside the driver (manual 1-2; 29-A 1304).

Knowledge test: 30 questions, 24 correct to pass (BMV drivers-license-exam page). Digital test in English, Spanish, Arabic, French, Canadian French, Portuguese, Somali, Lingala and Swahili; free professional interpreter for other languages since 2026-02-01.
The manual (3-5) still says only drivers under 18 are barred from phones; 29-A 2116 was repealed in 2019 and 29-A 2121 now bans hand-held use for all drivers.
Intermediate restrictions: 270 days from license issuance (statute; manual says from passing the road test), extended 270 days after a violation.
Move over (29-A 2054): pass in a non-adjacent lane if possible, otherwise at a careful and prudent speed; fines reported vary.
